panels.scene: Dana at Walt's front door with her small suitcase, leaving, Walt in the doorway, both smiling. Top third plain wall and sky.
dialogue: I'll call Sunday, same as always.
panels.caption: Say when you'll call next.

panels.scene: Dana in Walt's kitchen holding a plate by the sink, Walt beside her with a mug, raising one hand in good humour, the small green stovetop kettle on the stove behind them. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: Leave the dishes. I have a system.
panels.caption: Leave things the way they like them.

panels.scene: Dana sitting on a bus by the window, typing on her phone, smiling. Top third plain bus ceiling.
dialogue: Home now. Thanks for the chess lesson.
panels.caption: Send a note when you get home.
